    AI Overview
    Sienna Betts is the younger sister of UCLA basketball star Lauren Betts. A 6'4" forward and highly-ranked recruit, Sienna joined her sister at UCLA in 2025, making them teammates. They are part of a basketball-focused family that moved from Spain to Colorado, including younger brother Dylan. 
    • Teammates: Sienna and Lauren play together for the UCLA Bruins, with Lauren playing center and Sienna as a forward.
    • High School Background: Sienna played high school basketball at Grandview in Colorado.
    • Bond: Lauren has described having her sister on the floor with her as "unforgettable".
    • Other Siblings: Lauren has two other younger siblings named Dylan and Ashton.
    • Family Background: Their parents are Michelle and former professional basketball player Andy Betts.
